subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Shubhda has not finished __to paint__ the window.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Painting**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original sentence contains an infinitive ("**to paint**") after "finished," which is not grammatically correct.
 
• In English, it is more natural to use the gerund form in such constructions.
 
• The correct option is "**painting**" because it represents the gerund form of the verb "**paint**."
 
• Verbs like "**finish**," "**complete**," and "**enjoy**" are often followed by **gerunds **when **referring to an activity or action**.
 
• The **corrected sentence** is: "*Shubhda has not finished painting the window.*"
 
• In the sentence, the word "**painting**" acts as a gerund, and it functions as the **object of the verb** "**finished**."
 
• The structure "**finished painting**" indicates that Shubhda did not complete the action of painting the window.

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.
